hero.eyebrow: Natural mineral water · Niague spring, Senegal
hero.subtitle: Drawn from the heart of a preserved nature, naturally filtered through rock. Exceptional purity, balanced mineral content.

bottle.title: One water, six formats
bottle.text: From the 33 cl on-the-go bottle to the 19 L dispenser, the same demand for purity in every sip.

brandTeaser.title: Senegalese pride, raised to world standards
brandTeaser.text: O'Crystal was born from a simple ambition: to give Senegal and the sub-region a mineral water of impeccable purity, with the elegance of a great house.

sourceTeaser.title: From rock to bottle
sourceTeaser.text: The water flows slowly through the mineral layers of Niague, taking on calcium and magnesium, then is bottled at the source.

minerality.title: 320 mg/L of balanced minerality
minerality.text: Dry residue at 180 °C. A light water with fine, refreshing bubbles.

journey.title: From the Niague rock to the bottle

source.title: The source
source.text: Rainwater slowly seeps into a preserved nature, sheltered from surface pollution.

filtration.title: Natural filtration
filtration.text: As it passes through rock layers, it purifies and takes on calcium, magnesium and bicarbonates.

bottling.title: Bottled at the source
bottling.text: Drawn and bottled on site, the water keeps its original purity intact — nothing is added.
